# Security

Use GitHub **Security > Report a vulnerability** for private reports when enabled.
Otherwise contact the repository owner privately; do not post exploit details,
credentials or production data in a public issue.

Public CI never receives application/provider secrets and uses disposable standard
GitHub-hosted runners. It does not use the old private shared server. Free public
secret scanning and push protection are configured separately; verify the live
settings rather than treating this document as evidence.

- Never commit credentials, production data, raw SMS/email or user financial records.
- Keep money in integer minor units plus currency; calculations are deterministic and server-authoritative.
- Keep ledger history append-only, sharing default-deny and entitlements enforced by the server.
- The app must remain usable when optional permissions are denied.
- Preserve other agents' files, branches and findings; one active writer per checkout.
- Use additive contracts and serialize database migrations and protected merges.
- No paid runner, provider, storage allowance increase or production deployment without explicit approval.
